{
  "name": "loss_rank_gap_tanh_advantage",
  "intuition": "Shift from margin-based pairwise losses to a ranking loss that emphasizes the normalized rank gap weighted by relative advantage signals, capturing both ranking order and quality difference with a smooth tanh link to stabilize gradients.",
  "pseudocode": "rank_gap = rank_gap(lpw, lpl)  # normalized rank difference\nadvantage_diff = advantage_w - advantage_l\nscaled = tanh(beta * rank_gap * advantage_diff)\nloss = mean(weight * (1 - scaled))",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_ranking",
    "signal_family": "advantage_gap",
    "link_family": "tanh",
    "agg_family": "mean",
    "constraint_family": "none"
  },
  "operators_used": [
    "rank_gap",
    "tanh",
    "mean",

    "add",

  ],
  "implementation_hint": {
    "expects": [
      "log_prob_w",
      "log_prob_l",
      "weight",
      "advantage_w",
      "advantage_l"
    ],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))\n    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']\n    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']\n    beta = float(extra.get('beta', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('beta', 5.0)))\n    rg = ops.rank_gap(lpw, lpl)  # normalized rank gap\n    adv_diff = ops.sub(adv_w, adv_l)\n    scaled = ops.tanh(ops.mul(beta, ops.mul(rg, adv_diff)))\n    loss = ops.mean(ops.mul(weight, ops.sub(ops.ones_like(scaled), scaled)))\n    return loss"
}

{
  "name": "loss_logsigmoid_001_cost_sum",
  "intuition": "rule_based: pairwise logsigmoid loss with sum aggregation",
  "pseudocode": "loss = sum(-logsigmoid(clamp(alpha*scale*(lpw-lpl) - 0.1*gap, -20, 20)) * weight)",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_margin",
    "signal_family": "cost_gap",
    "link_family": "logsigmoid",
    "agg_family": "sum",
    "constraint_family": "clamp_stabilized"
  },
  "operators_used": [
    "logsigmoid",
    "clamp",
    "sum",
    "mul"
  ],
  "implementation_hint": {
    "expects": [
      "log_prob_w",
      "log_prob_l",
      "weight",
      "cost_a",
      "cost_b"
    ],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))\n    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.9496803035382082))\n    cost_a = batch['cost_a']\n    cost_b = batch['cost_b']\n    gap = (cost_b - cost_a).detach()\n    x = alpha * scale * (lpw - lpl) - 0.1 * gap\n    x = ops.clamp(x, -20.0, 20.0)\n    loss = -ops.logsigmoid(x)\n    if weight is not None:\n        loss = loss * weight\n    return ops.sum(loss)"
}

  "intuition": "To stabilize the original loss and ensure numerical robustness, we clamp the rank_gap input to tanh to a reasonable range to avoid saturation extremes, and also clamp the product before the ReLU to avoid very large values leading to instability.     lpl = batch['log_prob_l']

    advantage_l = batch['advantage_l']

    raw = ops.mul(score, diff)
    clamped_raw = ops.clamp(raw, 0.0, 10.0)
    loss_per_pair = ops.mul(ops.relu(clamped_raw), weight)
    return ops.mean(loss_per_pair)",

{
  "name": "loss_rank_gap_tanh_advantage",
  "intuition": "Shift from margin-based pairwise loss to a ranking-based paradigm using a tanh link that smoothly penalizes the difference in log-probabilities modulated by advantage signals, emphasizing relative ranking consistency rather than absolute margins.",
  "pseudocode": "diff = lpw - lpl\nadv_diff = advantage_w - advantage_l\nscaled_diff = scale * diff\nrank_penalty = tanh(scaled_diff) * adv_diff\nloss = mean(relu(rank_penalty)) weighted by weight",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_ranking",
    "signal_family": "advantage_gap",
    "link_family": "tanh",
    "agg_family": "mean",
    "constraint_family": "none"
  },
  "operators_used": [
    "tanh",
    "relu",
    "mean",
    "mul",
    "sub"
  ],
  "implementation_hint": {
    "expects": [
      "log_prob_w",
      "log_prob_l",
      "weight",
      "advantage_w",
      "advantage_l"
    ],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    advantage_w = batch['advantage_w']\n    advantage_l = batch['advantage_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.0))\n    diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)  # difference in log-prob\n    adv_diff = ops.sub(advantage_w, advantage_l)  # advantage gap\n    scaled_diff = ops.mul(scale, diff)\n    rank_penalty = ops.mul(ops.tanh(scaled_diff), adv_diff)\n    relu_penalty = ops.relu(rank_penalty)\n    if weight is not None:\n        relu_penalty = ops.mul(relu_penalty, weight)\n    return ops.mean(relu_penalty)"
}
